name: Logroño to Nájera
notes: from is Logroño (relation/340516, same point as stage 7 end). via: Navarrete, Sotés, Ventosa; Sotés lies 4.2 km south of the straight Logroño to Nájera line, so a reviewer should confirm the OSM Camino passes through it. The Alto de San Antón hill between Ventosa and Nájera was not looked up. extracts: la-rioja only; a Nominatim reverse lookup 3.0 km east of Logroño (42.4680,-2.4030) is La Rioja, so the Navarra border is beyond the 3 km corridor at the start. Nájera = relation/341364 (linked place=town).
